text:
Noah: Quick thread 1 1 Need to finalize design partner screening rubric + feedback ritual for the private beta. Questions: pilot length, checkpoint cadence, data handling guardrails, success/stop criteria. Draft ideas below.

Priya: Im thinking a 6-week pilot with 3 checkpoints: Kickoff, mid-pilot sync (~week 3), and wrap review. Each checkpoint = 30min. Success = product integration + qualitative NPS >= 6/10 + at least 2 actionable bugs flagged.

Jonas: For feedback ritual, propose: week 0 onboarding checklist, weekly 20-30m async feedback forms, and two 1:1 interviews (mid + end). Keep forms short: 5 quick metrics + 3 open prompts.

Claire: Screening rubric (we need to prioritize customers who can exercise Dedicated/Private features):
```
- Prod infra (yes=2, pilot=1)
- Security/regulatory need (yes=2)
- Latency-sensitive use cases (yes=1)
- Has infra/ML engineer assigned (yes=1)
- Token volume > threshold (yes=1)
```
Total >=4 = priority. I can run export from SFDC.

Noah: Love it. Also need explicit stop criteria to avoid doing unpaid support forever. Suggest stop triggers: no integration progress by week 4 OR repeated blocker from infra we cannot fix within 2 weeks.

Alex: Legal note: for Private previews we require an NDA + Data Processing Addendum (DPA) if they ingest sensitive data. Marketing incentives ok but must be opt-in on contract. I'll draft a short DPA template and a one-paragraph acceptable data-use blurb for invites.

Priya: Outreach copy idea (short + researcher tone):
```
Hi {{first_name}},
Would you trial Redwood Private for 6 weeks and help shape rollout controls + VPC UX? Well provide onboarding, technical support, and a $250 account credit or gift. Interested? Reply or pick a time: <cal link>
```
Prefer a checkpoint calendar invite and an async form link in the email.

Jonas: Survey skeleton (to embed as quick feedback):
1) How satisfied with latency/cost today (1-10)
2) How easy was onboarding (1-5)
3) Any regressions noticed? (y/n + text)
4) What feature would you prioritize next? (free text)

Claire: On SE side, handoff should include this minimal banner in Zendesk/Notion: account, stack diagram, blocker risk, desired throughput, contact. We need 24-48h SLA depending on priority.

Noah: Action items: Claire = export candidate list + run rubric by EOD Thu; Alex = DPA + blurb by Fri; Priya = finalize invite copy + survey link by Fri; Jonas = build google form + 2 interview scripts by Mon. Calendar-bot schedule kickoff window next Tue-Fri.

calendar-bot: Events created: "Private Beta Kickoff Window" Tue-Fri 1772300000-1772560000. Reminders set for organizers.

Alex: Quick Q on incentives: prefer account credit vs gift? Credits are simpler for enterprise finance but gifts feel more neutral. Legal ok with either.

Priya: Let's default to account credit for enterprise, gift for mid-market. We'll note it in outreach copy.

Noah: Great. One more thing  we should record mid-pilot demo video capture permission for research snippets. Add a checkbox in the consent flow.

Jonas: Will add consent checkbox and a line in the invite about anonymized snippets.

Priya: OK moving to execution. If anything blocks the DPA route ping Alex. Meeting if needed Thu 3pm. :thumbsup:
